title: Best Day Trips From Cairo (With Timings)
excerpt: The eight best day trips from Cairo, ranked with travel times, durations and prices from €29 to €71 (Nov 2026): Giza and the GEM, Saqqara, Alexandria, Fayoum and Minya.
body_html:
Prices, timetables and visiting details are a November 2026 snapshot. Check the linked official pages and your departure’s current inclusions and terms before booking.

Quick answer

For a first visit, the podium is fixed: Giza and the Grand Egyptian Museum in one full day, Saqqara and Dahshur for the pyramid's origin story, and Alexandria for the sea. Beyond them sit the Fayoum oasis days and, for return visitors, the long road to Minya and Amarna. Travel times run from about 45 minutes (Giza) to 4 hours each way (Minya): pick by travel time first, sights second.

Check current UK government travel advice for Egypt before making your arrangements; advice can change.

Key facts

Fact Detail
Where Giza and the GEM (Cairo's west) · Memphis, Saqqara, Dahshur (south) · Alexandria (north) · Fayoum (southwest) and Minya (south)
Travel times Giza about 45 to 60 min · Memphis and Saqqara about 1 hr · Alexandria about 3 hrs each way · Fayoum 1.5 to 2 hrs · Minya about 4 hrs each way
Typical cost Day tours from €29 to €71 per person, as listed in November 2026; inclusions vary by tour, so check each tour page
Group size Shared departures of up to 8 travellers, confirmed when four have reserved (the GoAhead)
Best time October to April, when the desert and road days are comfortable
Good for First-timers (Giza and the GEM), history lovers (Saqqara, Dahshur, Minya), sea-and-city fans (Alexandria), nature and desert seekers (Fayoum)
Not ideal for Travellers with no road patience (Alexandria is about 10 hours door to door); midsummer afternoons
Join them on Sawa All eight are in the catalogue as shared departures: see the forming departures

Cairo books four days easily and offers eight day trips: the traveller's problem is not finding things to do but allocating days between them. This guide ranks the eight day trips in our catalogue, each with its travel time, its door-to-door shape, what it costs and who it suits. The ranking is editorial and aimed at a first-time visitor with four Cairo days; return visitors should read the list backwards. It is written by the team behind Sawa Tours (sawa.tours), founded by an Egyptologist guide who has worked in Egyptian tourism since 1993.

The ranked list: Cairo's best day trips, with timings

"From" prices are per traveller, as listed in November 2026, and durations are door to door.

  1. Giza Pyramids, Sphinx & the Grand Egyptian Museum. Travel: about 45 to 60 minutes each way to Giza. About 8 hours: the pyramids, the panorama point, the Sphinx and Valley Temple, lunch, then a guided visit to the GEM. Hotel pickup, an Egyptologist, lunch and both tickets are included; the pyramid interior and camel rides are not. Best for: everyone on a first visit, the day Cairo exists for. From €71. More in Pyramids and the Grand Egyptian Museum in One Day.
  2. Memphis, Saqqara & Dahshur: Birth of the Pyramid. Travel: about an hour each way south. About 9 hours: Memphis, Saqqara's Step Pyramid enclosure, lunch, then Dahshur's Bent and Red Pyramids. Hotel pickup, an Egyptologist, lunch and tickets are included; going inside the Red Pyramid is covered by the site ticket and your guide advises on the day, while the Serapeum is a separate ticket and not included. Best for: the pyramid's origin story, and the best value among the full days. From €33.
  3. Giza Uncovered: Pyramids, Sphinx & Stories. Travel: about 45 to 60 minutes each way. About 4 hours: the plateau ticket, the panorama viewpoint and the Sphinx, without the museum. The Great Pyramid interior, camels and meals are not included. Best for: travellers pairing the GEM separately, or squeezing Giza into a half-day. From €29, the lowest price on this list.
  4. Secrets of the Grand Egyptian Museum. Travel: about 30 to 45 minutes to Giza. About 3 hours in the museum, with general admission included; special exhibitions and separately ticketed areas are not. Best for: museum people, rainy-day insurance, and anyone who wants the Tutankhamun story told properly. From €48.
  5. Cairo to Alexandria: the Mediterranean Day Tour. Travel: about 3 hours each way. About 10 hours: the Catacombs of Kom El Shuqafa, Pompey's Pillar, the National Museum of Alexandria, lunch, and the Roman Amphitheatre before the drive home. Hotel pickup, a guide, lunch and tickets are included. Best for: Greco-Roman history and sea air on a second or third Cairo day. From €47.
  6. Fayoum Oasis, Meidum & Hawara. Travel: about 1.5 to 2 hours each way southwest. About 11 hours: the collapsed Meidum pyramid, Hawara and the Labyrinth site, lunch, then Lake Qarun and the Fayoum countryside. Best for: travellers who have seen the classic pyramids and want the experiments. From €64. More in Fayoum in a Day from Cairo.
  7. Whale Valley & Wadi El Rayan Desert Safari. Travel: about 2 hours each way to Fayoum, then into the desert. About 11 hours: Tunis Village, Lake Qarun, the Wadi El Rayan waterfalls, Wadi Al-Hitan's whale fossils on foot, then the dunes and the Magic Lake before the evening drive home. Best for: nature lovers, photographers, families with older children. From €67.
  8. Full Day Minya Archaeological Tour. Travel: about 4 hours each way south. About 15 hours: Beni Hassan's rock-cut tombs, Hermopolis and Tuna el-Gebel, then Tell el-Amarna, Akhenaten's lost city. Best for: return visitors and Amarna-period obsessives; it is the longest day on this list. From €52.

Check each tour page for the full list of inclusions before you book.

How the travel times actually work

The site time is fixed; the variable is Cairo traffic, which is why these days start early. Read the durations door to door: the Alexandria day is about 10 hours with around 6 of them driving, and the Giza and GEM day is about 8 hours with far less road. Two pairing rules follow. First, Giza and the GEM pair naturally in one day, because they sit a short drive apart. Second, do not stack Alexandria against a big Giza day; give each its own morning.

Hotel pickup is included on the tours that list it; otherwise the departure page shows the meeting point. The Minya day is the longest on the list, so check the pickup details on the departure page.

Which day trip suits you?

  • First visit, four days: the ranked order above is the plan: Giza and the GEM, then Saqqara and Dahshur, then your pick of Alexandria or the Fayoum.
  • The story of the pyramid: entry 2, Memphis, Saqqara and Dahshur, oldest to boldest, the best-value full day on the list.
  • Museum people: entry 4, with the Grand Egyptian Museum itself as the destination.
  • Sea, Greeks and Romans: entry 5. Kom El Shuqafa is among the largest Roman-era burial sites in Egypt.
  • Nature, desert and fossils: entries 6 and 7: the Fayoum oasis day for the quiet version, the 4x4 safari for the full desert afternoon.
  • Return visitors: entry 8. Amarna and Beni Hassan are the sites most itineraries never reach.

The short version

Cairo's best day trips, in order: Giza with the Grand Egyptian Museum, the Saqqara and Dahshur origin story, Giza Uncovered or the GEM alone as half-days, Alexandria for the sea, the Fayoum oasis and desert safari for nature, and Minya for the deep cut. Travel times run 45 minutes to 4 hours each way, prices from €29 to €71, as listed in November 2026, and every guided trip runs with a licensed guide. Cairo is the only city where you can finish breakfast at the pyramids and lunch by the sea. Reserve free on the forming departures.

faq.q: What are the best day trips from Cairo?
faq.a: For a first visit: Giza with the Grand Egyptian Museum, then Memphis, Saqqara and Dahshur, then Alexandria if the sea appeals. Fayoum and its desert safari suit nature lovers, and Minya is the return visitor's deep cut. Every trip is a shared departure with a licensed guide, from €29 to €71 per person, as listed in November 2026.

faq.q: Can you do Giza and the Grand Egyptian Museum in one day?
faq.a: Yes. That is exactly how the combined day is built: the pyramids, panorama point and Sphinx first, lunch, then the GEM, in about 8 hours from €71 with both tickets and lunch included. Doing them as two separate days spends a second day on the same drive.

faq.q: Is Alexandria worth the drive from Cairo?
faq.a: If Greco-Roman history and the Mediterranean appeal, yes: the Catacombs of Kom El Shuqafa are among the largest Roman-era burial sites in Egypt, and the day adds Pompey's Pillar, the National Museum and the Roman theatre. The honest cost is the road: about 3 hours each way, six of the day's ten hours. Go on a second or third Cairo day, not the first.

faq.q: What is the easiest day trip from Cairo without a tour?
faq.a: Giza, by app taxi: the site is close to the city, and entry and tickets are now at the Pyramids Visitor Centre on the Cairo to Fayoum road rather than at the old gate. GEM tickets are sold online only. Everything else on this list runs better with a tour, because entrance tickets, a licensed guide and the long-road and desert logistics are exactly what a shared departure handles for you.

faq.q: Do I need to book Cairo day tours in advance?
faq.a: In peak months (October to April), yes for the popular days: Giza with the GEM and the Alexandria run fill first. On Sawa, reserving is free, the date confirms at four travellers (the GoAhead), and a date that has not reached four by seven days before the tour is cancelled, with nothing charged. Book the anchors early and improvise the rest.
